article.title: 又 con negación: inferencia y acomodación
article.part: Información y discurso avanzado — 信息與進階篇章
article.chapter: Tema, foco, elipsis y cadenas referenciales — 主題、焦點、省略與指稱鏈

claims.summary: Xue and Jiang (2023) analyze a quasi-logical use of 又 in naturally occurring conversation. For the construction [又 + negation + right conjunct], they argue that the logical and presuppositional meanings do not yield a coherent reading on their own; the listener accommodates an implicit conditional premise to infer the utterance. They locate the inference in the construction, not in 又 alone. This is an account of accommodation and pragmatic inference, not evidence that the ordinary ‘again’ presupposition is freely cancelable.

locator.passage: Abstract, pp. 16–17: natural conversation, generalized conjunctive use of 又, [又 + negation + right conjunct], accommodation of an implicit conditional premise; repository record confirms article metadata and peer-review status.

links.notes: La entrada fue restringida a la afirmación y al alcance expresamente publicados; las generalizaciones y ejemplos previos sin fuente se retiraron.
